title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
issuingAuthority: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers’ Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare
summary: PM-KISAN gives ₹6,000 a year to farmer families who own farm land. The money comes straight into your bank account in three parts of ₹2,000 each: April–July, August–November and December–March. Families are not eligible if anyone in the family pays income tax, works or worked for the government, gets a pension of ₹10,000 or more a month, or is a practising doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect.

benefits.description: ₹6,000 a year, paid as three instalments of ₹2,000 (April–July, August–November, December–March)
benefits.sourceClause: The financial benefit of Rs.6000/- per year is to be released to the eligible farmers in three installments of Rs.2000/- each every 4-month / trimester

benefits.description: Money goes directly into your bank account (Direct Benefit Transfer)
benefits.sourceClause: released by the Central Government online directly into the bank accounts of the eligible farmers under Direct Benefit Transfer mode

eligibility.label: Your family (husband, wife, minor children) owns farm land in the land records
eligibility.sourceClause: A landholder farmer’s family is defined as “a family comprising of husband, wife and minor children who owns cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT”.

eligibility.label: No one in your family holds or held a constitutional post
eligibility.sourceClause: i) Former and present holders of constitutional posts

eligibility.label: No one in your family is or was a Minister, MP, MLA/MLC, Mayor or District Panchayat Chairperson
eligibility.sourceClause: ii) Former and present Ministers / State Ministers and former / present Members of Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha / State Legislative Assemblies / State Legislative Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats.

eligibility.label: No one in your family is a serving or retired government or PSU officer/employee (Group D, Class IV and Multi Tasking Staff are allowed)
eligibility.sourceClause: iii) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central / State Government Ministries / Offices / Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached offices / Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular

eligibility.label: No one in your family gets a pension of ₹10,000 or more a month (Group D, Class IV and Multi Tasking Staff are allowed)
eligibility.sourceClause: iv) All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/- or more (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)

eligibility.label: No one in your family paid income tax in the last assessment year
eligibility.sourceClause: v) All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.

eligibility.label: No one in your family is a practising doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA or architect
eligibility.sourceClause: vi) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.

eligibility.label: You are not a Non-Resident Indian (NRI)
eligibility.sourceClause: (c) In case of new beneficiaries being uploaded on the PM-KISAN Portal, all land holding farmers’ families who are Non-resident Indians (NRIs) in terms of the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 shall be excluded from any benefit under the Scheme.

documentsRequired: Bank account number and IFSC code
Land record details (for example Khasra or survey number)

steps: Make sure your family's name is in the land records. Your State government finds eligible families from these records.
Give a self-declaration that no one in your family is in the excluded groups, and agree to Aadhaar verification.
Give your name, age, gender, category, Aadhaar number, and bank account number with IFSC code.
Local revenue officials check the list, and the State uploads it to the PM-KISAN portal.
Check the list put up at your Panchayat. If your family was left out, you can raise a complaint.
Be truthful: if a self-declaration is wrong, the money can be taken back and legal action can follow.

realWorldImpact: Eligible farming families get direct money of ₹6,000 every year to help purchase farm tools, seeds, and meet basic household expenses.
